newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos opens second hotel at Tunica.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos opens second hotel at Tunica.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Thursday it opened a second hotel, a six-story unit with 578 rooms, at Grand Casino Tunica in Tunica County, Miss.
The new hotel is in addition to an existing 188-room hotel. Since opening in September 1996, occupancy has exceeded 94 percent with an average daily rate of approximatley $60.
The new hotel was built at a cost of $45 million, bringing Grand Casinos' total investment at the Tunica property to $430 million.
Grand Casinos owns and operates three casino hotel resorts in Mississippi, manages two land-based casinos in Louisiana and manages two casino hotel resorts in Minnesota.
